name: Hearts Aglow
original_name: เงารักใต้แสงเทียน
overview: Loy, a city boy seeking peace, escapes to a rural homestay where he meets Kaew, a gentle soul rooted in tradition. Amid shared meals, rain-soaked evenings, and simple rituals, their quiet moments blossom into a tender love. Beyond their story, other relationships unfold within the homestay, each carrying its own form of love. Three different connections, each shining in its own way.
